mentions.note: passed Dental Exams at Chatham; sent to Skegness
stationed at Skegness; 3rd in a 12½ miles race at Battley, won the handicap, first Services man; 9th in R.W.A. 5-miles

mentions.h: LETTERS AND NEWS HAVE BEEN RECEIVED FROM:
mentions.note: won the Northern Command 12-Miles Forces Race in 1.50.38 off 20 minutes handicap, by 12m.19
helped produce the Belgrave News Letter

mentions.h: LETTERS AND NEWS HAVE BEEN RECEIVED FROM:

mentions.note: unable to get down for our Open; down for the Highgate match in November
performed on the radio in Merry-Go-Round; walked to help the Club win the wartime Surrey County Road-Walking title; stationed in Lincs
performed at the Pavilion, Bognor Regis
"The Banjulele Boy"; won the 1929 Boxing Day Walk Handicap
